name: Statping
tagline: An Easy To Use Status Page For Your Websites And Applications. Statping Will Automatically Fetch The Application And Render A Beautiful Status Page With Tons Of Features For You To Build An Even Better Status Page.
description: An easy to use Status Page for your websites and applications. Statping will automatically fetch the application and render a beautiful status page with tons of features for you to build an even better status page.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Db pass
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: statping/statping:v0.90.74
    restart: always
    depends_on:
      - db
    environment:
      VIRTUAL_PORT: 8080
      DB_CONN: postgres
      DB_HOST: db
      DB_USER: bigbear
      DB_PASS: ${SECRET_DB_PASS}
      DB_DATABASE: casaos
      NAME: ''
      DESCRIPTION: ''
    ports:
      - target: 8080
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/app
        target: /app
  db:
    image: postgres:18.6
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      POSTGRES_USER: bigbear
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_DB_PASS}
      POSTGRES_DB: casaos
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/postgres/data
        target: /var/lib/postgresql/data
